listing.name: Thog's [REDACTED] - More Remnant Drones
listing.summary: Adds 13 new remnant drone ships, six fighter wings, and six weapons, including hybrid energy flak weapons and a small-slot Dragonfire DEM.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 13 new remnant drone ships, six fighter wings, and six weapons, including hybrid energy flak weapons and a small-slot Dragonfire DEM.

description:
Like light blue funny autonomous drones, but can't get ENOUGH of them? Want to fight a huge modular drone super-carrier to conquer and add to your own stupendous autonomous fleet? Or maybe you want to spam a ton of small, pesky, cheap drone frigates instead?

Then you've come to the right place. Again.

GET IT HERE:https://github.com/caninmyham/THG-REDACTED/releases/download/RELEASE3/Thogs.REDACTED.zip

Currently, the mod adds a total of 13 different new remnant drone ships, along with six fighter wings and six weapons, including a number of hybrid-mount energy-based flak weapons and a small-slot single Dragonfire DEM.

As always, any and all feedback is welcome both here and on the Starsector discord. Enjoy!
